# Third-party runtime dependencies

TopMonitor's publish script downloads the following official, pinned Windows x64
runtime files. The binaries are hash-verified and are not committed to this
repository.

## PresentMon 2.4.1

- File: `PresentMon.exe`
- Source: <https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/tag/v2.4.1>
- Project license: MIT
- SHA-256: `D74183E7AE630F72CD3690BE0373ECBFDC6CBB86578148AAB8FA2A7166068F34`

## PawnIO installer distributed with LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6

- File: `PawnIO_setup.exe`
- Source commit: <https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/tree/3d331e3370efb858411f19511373eff65a218701>
- LibreHardwareMonitor project license: Mozilla Public License 2.0
- PawnIO upstream: <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO>
- SHA-256: `A3A46226C5E2824F4CDD42BE0EECBABFC672C86F7889710F5AB1E6AD385B47A0`

Refer to each upstream project for its complete license and notices.
